hero.title: Work Type Configuration
hero.description: Review published Work Types, prepare controlled drafts, and publish versioned rules without changing existing Work history.

states.noWorkTypesDescription: There are no Work Types available in this office for the current filter.
states.selectWorkTypeDescription: Choose a Work Type from the list to review its published version, draft, and history.

detail.noDescription: No description has been recorded for this Work Type.

draft.reasonPlaceholder: Briefly explain why this version is needed

configuration.title: Ownership, creators, closure and SLA
configuration.description: These rules are stored in this draft version and become immutable after publication.
configuration.creatorAccountsDescription: Select only accounts that are allowed to create this Work Type directly.

fields.title: Work fields
fields.description: Configure the controlled data fields used by this Work Type version.
fields.emptyDescription: Add only the fields required by this Work Type.
fields.label: Label
fields.optionsPlaceholder: Option A, Option B, Option C

stages.title: Workflow stages
stages.description: Define responsibility and assignment rules. Runtime Work stages are created later from the published version.
stages.emptyDescription: A publishable Work Type needs at least one required stage.
stages.name: Stage name

dependencies.title: Stage dependencies
dependencies.description: Use dependencies only when a stage must wait for another stage to finish.
dependencies.none: No dependencies configured. Stages may proceed in parallel when their activation rules allow it.

release.title: Draft release
release.publishDescription: Save the draft configuration before publishing. Publishing retires the previous published version and keeps its history intact.
release.draftOnlyDescription: You can prepare this draft, but only the Office Head can publish the final version.
release.confirmPublishDescription: This makes the draft the published version for future Work. Existing Work remains linked to its original version.
release.confirmDiscardDescription: This removes the current draft only. Published and retired versions remain unchanged.

readonly.title: Read-only Work Type oversight
readonly.description: You can review published rules and version history. Draft, edit, discard, and publish actions are not available for your account.

history.title: Version history
history.description: Published and retired versions remain readable so historical Work keeps its original meaning.

errors.loadWorkTypes: Unable to load Work Types for this office.
errors.loadDetail: Unable to load Work Type details.
errors.saveConfiguration: Unable to save Work Type configuration.

simple.title: Work Types
simple.description: Set up the types of Work used by your Office.
simple.removedEmptyDescription: Deleted Work Types will appear here and can be restored.
simple.emptyDescription: Add a Work Type to get started.
simple.changeNeeded: Start changes before editing this Work Type.

new.title: Add Work Type
new.description: Give the Work Type a clear name and short description. You can set up its form, steps and rules next.
new.name: Work Type name

details.title: Details
details.description: Keep the name and description clear for the people who will use this Work Type.
details.name: Name

makeAvailable.title: Make this Work Type available
makeAvailable.description: Changes affect new Work only. Existing Work keeps its original rules.
makeAvailable.notReady: Complete these items before making this Work Type available:

form.title: Form
form.description: These are the questions shown when someone creates this Work Type.
form.emptyDescription: Add only the information people need to create this Work.
form.question: Question
form.attachmentOptional: Required files and images are collected during a Work step.
form.recallEditable: Recall the saved value and allow correction

steps.title: Work steps
steps.description: Set the steps people follow to finish this Work.
steps.name: Step name
steps.executionApprovalHelp: Execution uses no separate approval. The Responsible Reviewer performs the final Work review.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Choose who owns this Work, who can create it and when it is complete.
rules.responsibleReviewer: Responsible Reviewer selected for each Work
rules.responsibleReviewerHelp: The reviewer must be an active Head in the Main Team or Primary Owner hierarchy and is selected when the Work is created.

errors.create: Could not create the Work Type.
errors.remove: Could not delete the Work Type.
errors.restore: Could not restore the Work Type.

assignmentSection.title: Assignment
assignmentSection.description: Choose the owning organization and how the main Work is performed.
assignmentSection.performerHelp: Choose the execution model people will use when this Work is created.
assignmentSection.executionMissing: Add a required Work execution step before configuring assignment.
assignmentSection.supportTitle: Support and cross-organization help are included automatically
assignmentSection.supportHelp: Support Members, Need Help and additional participating organizations use the common Work foundation and are not configured again for each Work Type.

help.ORG_UNIT_QUEUE: Work starts in the owning organization queue.
help.TEAM: A Main Team is selected when Work is created.
help.ORG_UNIT_OR_TEAM: Work can use an organization queue or a Main Team.
help.ORG_UNIT_OR_USER: Work can be assigned to an organization or an individual person.
help.TEAM_OR_USER: Choose either a Main Team or one individual employee when the Work is created.

information.title: Information
information.description: Configure only the business information that is different for this Work Type. Choose when each field is collected.
information.foundationNote: Start Work, Need Help, Support Members, notes, evidence and final review are already provided by the common Work foundation.
information.commonCompletionTitle: Included automatically in every Work Type
information.commonCompletionDescription: These required completion questions are part of the Work foundation. They are shown to the worker when finishing Work and cannot be removed from an individual Work Type.
information.workResultValues: Work finished / Temporary work done / Could not finish
information.summaryRequired: The worker must describe the work completed before submitting for review.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Set additional organization steps and the order they must follow. The main execution step is always part of the Work foundation.
workflow.presetsHelp: Use a preset as a starting point, then adjust only what this Work Type needs.
workflow.dependenciesHelp: Define which step must finish before another step can proceed.

review.title: Review & Publish
review.description: Check the Work Type in business language before making it available. Existing Work keeps the version it was created with.
review.foundationTitle: Common Work controls are included automatically
review.foundationHelp: Start Work, Need Help, Support Members, notes, evidence, completion controls, Responsible Reviewer, Return for Correction, Approve & Complete, history, automatic Registered/Due time and AD/BS are platform-owned and are not recreated here.
review.ready: This Work Type is ready to publish.
